headline: Kratos' whole story in 60 seconds
title: Kratos Story Explained in 60 Seconds | God of War Lore
video_script: Here's Kratos' whole story, fast. A Spartan captain, Kratos pledged himself to Ares to win a battle. Ares tricked him into killing his own wife and daughter, and their ashes turned his skin white. He became the Ghost of Sparta, killed Ares and became the God of War. Betrayed by Zeus, he destroyed Olympus. Years later in the Norse lands, he raised his son Atreus, and together they survived Ragnarok. Favourite era? Comment below!

scenes.sub: The Ghost of Sparta is born

description: Kratos' story in 60 seconds: the Spartan tricked by Ares, the Ghost of Sparta, the fall of Olympus, and his new life in the Norse realms with Atreus through Ragnarok.
